details.description: The login function lacks rate limiting mechanisms, allowing attackers to perform unlimited brute force attempts against user credentials.
details.fix_explanation: Added rate limiting with MAX_ATTEMPTS=5 and LOCKOUT_DURATION_MS=15 minutes. Function checkRateLimit() enforces this. Failed attempts are recorded with recordFailedAttempt().
details.secure_code_snippet: function checkRateLimit(user: string): boolean { const now = Date.now(); const attempt = loginAttempts.get(user); if (!attempt) return true; if (now - attempt.timestamp > LOCKOUT_DURATION_MS) { loginAttempts.delete(user); return true; } return attempt.count < MAX_ATTEMPTS; }

details.description: PBKDF2 iteration count only checks if positive (> 0), but no upper bound or minimum recommended value. Very low iterations make password cracking feasible. No validation of salt or derived key length.
details.fix_explanation: Added validation: iterations must be between 10000 and 1000000 (industry standard). Validate salt length is 32 bytes and derived hash is 64 hex characters. These prevent malformed or weak hash formats.
details.secure_code_snippet: if (!Number.isFinite(iterations) || iterations < 10000 || iterations > 1000000) return false; if (salt.length !== 32) return false; if (derived.length !== 64) return false;

details.description: The login function accepts user and pass parameters without validation. No checks for null, undefined, type validation, or length limits. Could lead to injection attacks or resource exhaustion.
details.fix_explanation: Added validateLoginInput() function that checks: parameters are non-null strings, username ≤ 256 chars, password ≤ 1024 chars. Prevents type confusion and excessively long inputs that could consume memory.
details.secure_code_snippet: function validateLoginInput(user: string, pass: string): { valid: boolean; error?: string } { if (!user || typeof user !== 'string') return { valid: false, error: 'Invalid username' }; if (user.length > 256 || pass.length > 1024) return { valid: false, error: 'Input too long' }; return { valid: true }; }

hardcoded_secrets.details: No hardcoded secrets detected. All sensitive data is loaded from environment variables (STRIPE_API_KEY, DB_URI, JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_USER, ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH, PRIVATE_KEY_PATH).

notes: The code properly uses environment variables for all sensitive credentials.
Recommendation: Replace PBKDF2 with bcrypt or argon2 for production password hashing.
Recommendation: Consider implementing distributed rate limiting (Redis) for multi-instance deployments.
Recommendation: Add comprehensive logging for authentication attempts.
Recommendation: Implement account lockout notifications to users.
